rules.name: Blessing of the Crescent Moon
rules.description:
Universal Rule.
All models in a unit containing one or more models with this rule gain +1 Agility.

rules.name: Prayers of the Kami
rules.description:
Universal Rule.
The model can cast the following Spells from Cosmology as Bound Spells with Power Level (4/8). These spellscan only target the Yamabushi’s unit or enemy units in base contact with the Yamabushi.
• Altered Sight
• Perception of Strength
• Unity in Divergence

rules.name: Iaijutsu
rules.description:
Attack Attribute.
At step 5 of the Round of Combat Sequence (after issuing and accepting Duels), the model must use one of the
following fighting techniques and apply its effects until the end of the Round of Combat if it is fighting in a Duel.
• Drawing the Void: Aegis (+1).
• Ritual of Steel: +2 Armour Penetration with with Close Combat Attacks.
• A single Moment: Lightning Reflexes.

rules.name: Duellist
rules.description:
Universal Rule.
Unless another friendly Daimyo does so first, a Kensai must issue or accept Duels whenever possible.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Lightning Reflexes, Multiple Wounds (2, against Characters), Poison Attacks, Paired Weapons, Shuriken (2+)

rules.name: Professional Courtesy
rules.description:
Universal Rule.
Shinobi cannot join or be deployed in units that contain another Shinobi.

rules.name: Strike from the Shadows
rules.description:
Strike from the Shadows: Universal Rule.
The Shinobi cannot be deployed during the Deployment Phase. Instead, at the start of any Player Turn, the owner may choose a friendly Standard Infantry unit that is not Fleeing and apply the following rules:
• Remove a R&F model from the chosen unit’s front rank as a casualty. Deploy the Shinobi in the position of
the removed model.
• You cannot remove the last R&F model from a unit, and removing the model never causes a Panic Test.
• The Shinobi cannot voluntarily leave its unit during the Player Turn in which it was deployed.
• If the Shinobi is not deployed by the end of Game Turn 4, it counts as a casualty and cannot be deployed
for the rest of the game.

characteristics.$text: Distracting, Hard Target (1), Light Armour, Shield

rules.name: Kyudo
rules.description:
Attack Attribute – Shooting.
The Shooting Attack gains Shots 2. Additionally, when shooting from Short Range, the attack gains +1 Armour Penetration.

rules.name: Summoned from the Underworld
rules.description:
Universal Rule.
The model cannot benefit from Commanding Presence or Rally Around the Flag.

rules.name: Fox Fire
rules.description:
Universal Rule.
Enemy models in units in Base Contact with one or more Kitsune suffer -1 Offensive Skill, -1 Defensive Skill and -1 Agility.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Breath Attack (Str 4, AP 1, Flaming Attacks),Magical Attacks

rules.name: Blessings of the Kami
rules.description:
Universal Rule.
Friendly units in 8" gain Aegis (5+, against Ranged Attacks). Additionally, the model may cast Ancestral Aid (Evocation) as a Bound Spell with Power Level (4/8).

rules.name: War Shrine
rules.description:
War Shrine: Universal Rule.
The model gains War Platform, +1 Resilience, changes its Base to 60×100 mm and must be deployed in a friendly infantry unit with Scoring.
It can never voluntarily leave its unit.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: The bearer gains +1 Resilience against Ranged Attacks. This has no effect on Flaming Attacks or Toxic Attacks.

characteristics.name: Attributes
characteristics.$text: Hand Weapon. Attacks made with this weapon gain +1 Strength, +1 Offensive Skill and ignore Parry

sharedRules.name: Ritual Meditation
sharedRules.description:
Dispelling rolls from your opponent against Augment Spells suffer a -1 modifier if more than half of the models
affected by the Spell have this rule. This also affects Bound Spells.

sharedRules.name: Sashimonos
sharedRules.description:
Each side with 5 or more models with Sashimonos adds +1 to its Combat Score. Large models with Sashimonos
count as 2 models for this purpose. These models do not have to be in the same unit.

sharedRules.name: Way of the Warrior
sharedRules.description:
You cannot refuse a Duel if a model with Way of the Warrior could accept it. If at least half of the models in a unit have this rule, the first Break Test taken by the unit in each Close Combat is subject to Minimised Roll. A unit or Character with this rule that fails a Break Test during the game counts as a Shattered Unit, unless it is already a
Destroyed Unit, when determining Victory Points.

sharedRules.name: Kenjutsu
sharedRules.description:
Attack Attribute – Close Combat
For every X successful to-hit rolls against the same Health Pool, an additional hit is caused. Count seperately for each Character and each Initiative Step. While fighting in a Duel, the model part decreases the value of X by 1 until the Duel ends (up to a minimum of 1). If a model has multiple instances of Kenjutsu (X), use the one with the lowest value for X.

sharedRules.name: Mon of the Ashiwara Clan
sharedRules.description:
Models with this Mon gain Quick to Fire and may use Shooting Attacks from the third rank (in addition to the first and second one).
The Yumi (Longbow) of a Daimyo with this Mon gains Shots 4.
The Yumi (Longbow) of a Hatamoto with this Mon gains Shots 3.

sharedRules.name: Mon of the Daimatsu Clan
sharedRules.description:
Infantry only.
Models with this Mon gain Distracting in the first Round of each Combat.

sharedRules.name: Mon of the Horumi Clan
sharedRules.description:
Warrior Monks and Yamabushi with this Mon gain Aegis (5+, against Melee Attacks).
Each Yamabushi, Shugenja and Mikoshi Shrine with this Mon generates a Veil Token at the beginning of the game and allows storing an additional Veil Token at the end of Siphon the Veil (up to a maximum of 6 Veil Tokens).
Shugenja with this Mon additionally gain access to the Path:
Divination

sharedRules.name: Mon of the Shinzei Clan
sharedRules.description:
Models with this Mon gain Vanguard, +1 Armour Penetration and can re-roll failed Ambush rolls.
Additionally, the army ignores the 0-1 limit for Shinobi.

sharedRules.name: Mon of the Taneka Clan
sharedRules.description:
Cannot be taken by Infantry models.
Model parts with this Mon and with Kenjutsu (X) gain Devastating Charge (Kenjutsu (2)).
